bugs.title: Bot books appointment without escalating allergy mention
bugs.description: Customer mentions ammonia allergy TWICE (turn 1 and 7) during booking flow for a hair tint service. The bot acknowledges 'Anotado el tinte y la alergia al amoníaco' (turn 2) but continues the booking flow without calling the escalate tool or halting to seek human validation of product compatibility. The appointment is confirmed and persisted in DB with status=confirmed.
bugs.expected: Bot calls escalate tool after allergy mention. Human operator validates whether salon has ammonia-free products before confirming. Outcome: escalated.
bugs.actual: Bot says 'Anotado' (noted) and continues booking. Appointment booked and confirmed. No escalation tool called across all 7 turns.
bugs.root_cause_hypothesis: The system prompt or critical_rules.md does not have an explicit rule requiring escalation on allergy/health-safety mentions. The bot treats the allergy as a note (customer_memories) rather than a safety-escalation trigger. The escalation_tools are not triggered because no rule maps 'allergy mention' to the escalate tool.
